First semi-abstract paintings: trees and houses reflected in water
Joined the Dutch branch of the Theosophical Society
Moved to Paris; changed name from Mondriaan to Mondrian
In the Netherlands during the war; Laren artists' colony, met Bart van der Leck and Theo van Doesburg
Co-founded De Stijl with Theo van Doesburg; published 'De Nieuwe Beelding in de schilderkunst' (1917–18)
Paris; studio as a work of art; neoplastic compositions in primary colours
Died of pneumonia in New York; buried at Cypress Hills Cemetery, Brooklyn
